name: Firebase
description: Google's app platform: authentication, Firestore, storage, functions and messaging.

pricing.notes: Spark (free) plan has fixed caps (e.g. 50K Firestore reads/day). Blaze keeps those free allowances, then bills per use (e.g. $0.40/million function invocations) — no flat subscription tier exists. Checked 2026-08-07.
